<summary><strong>DeepSeek TUI</strong> — <a href="https://github.com/Hmbown/DeepSeek-TUI">Hmbown/DeepSeek-TUI</a></summary>

**DeepSeek TUI Community Digest for 2026-09-06**

### Today's Highlights
The DeepSeek TUI community saw significant updates with the release of v0.9.12, which includes various fixes and enhancements. Notably, the `codewhale` command and npm package have been updated, and the legacy npm package `deepseek-tui` is now deprecated. Additionally, several issues and pull requests have been addressed, focusing on improving the overall user experience and stability of the platform.

### Releases
- **v0.9.12**: This release marks a significant milestone with the introduction of `codewhale` as the public product from Shannon Labs, replacing the legacy `deepseek-tui` package. It includes updates to the `codewhale` command, npm package, and release-asset names, all of which are now lowercase technical identifiers. [Release Details](https://github.com/Hmbown/DeepSeek-TUI/releases)

### Hot Issues
1. **#5573**: This issue is a milestone tracker for v0.9.12, serving as a starting point for various tasks and decisions, including operator handoff and product authority definitions. [Issue #5573](https://github.com/Hmbown/Codewhale/issues/5573)
2. **#5316**: EPIC-005 focuses on CodeWhale TUI Crate Decomposition, an umbrella issue tracking the decomposition of the CodeWhale TUI crate. [Issue #5316](https://github.com/Hmbown/Codewhale/issues/5316)
3. **#5820**: This closed issue addressed the problem of the Ollama provider's input budget collapsing to 1024 tokens on 32K local models. [Issue #5820](https://github.com/Hmbown/Codewhale/issues/5820)
4. **#2323**: An open issue regarding the lack of adaptation for Chinese input methods, causing various problems such as incorrect input display. [Issue #2323](https://github.com/Hmbown/Codewhale/issues/2323)
5. **#5863**: A closed enhancement issue for ACP Function, which previously did not expose session config options. [Issue #5863](https://github.com/Hmbown/Codewhale/issues/5863)
6. **#5769**: A closed bug issue where network errors sometimes caused the engine to stop. [Issue #5769](https://github.com/Hmbown/Codewhale/issues/5769)
7. **#5888**: An open issue suggesting simplification of the Fleet menu to reduce the number of options presented at once. [Issue #5888](https://github.com/Hmbown/Codewhale/issues/5888)
8. **#5887**: An open issue regarding MCP startup staying on “20 connecting” for a long time, indicating a need for better progress indication. [Issue #5887](https://github.com/Hmbown/Codewhale/issues/5887)
9. **#5846**: An open issue proposing voice input enhancements, including on-device STT default, API-key fallback, and keybinding plus level animation. [Issue #5846](https://github.com/Hmbown/Codewhale/issues/5846)
10. **#5898**: An open bug issue to stabilize the Windows worker-idle-timeout regression test, which is intermittently failing. [Issue #5898](https://github.com/Hmbown/Codewhale/issues/5898)

### Key PR Progress
1. **#5900**: A fix to align shell guidance with execution, ensuring models infer the correct syntax based on the selected interpreter. [PR #5900](https://github.com/Hmbown/Codewhale/pull/5900)
2. **#5899**: A fix to show published Cargo sources without the dev marker, making the versioning more accurate. [PR #5899](https://github.com/Hmbown/Codewhale/pull/5899)
3. **#5895**: A fix to prevent HarmonyOS file-read cleanup from deleting unrelated temporary files, enhancing file management. [PR #5895](https://github.com/Hmbown/Codewhale/pull/5895)
4. **#5897**: A fix to show startup progress as each server connects, improving the user experience during MCP startup. [PR #5897](https://github.com/Hmbown/Codewhale/pull/5897)
5. **#5893**: A closed PR that verifies all crate tarballs before the first upload, ensuring the integrity of published crates. [PR #5893](https://github.com/Hmbown/Codewhale/pull/5893)
6. **#5890**: A closed PR that packages built-in computer-use files inside the TUI crate, streamlining the release process. [PR #5890](https://github.com/Hmbown/Codewhale/pull/5890)
7. **#5869**: A closed PR that preserves task origin in job snapshots, enhancing job management and debugging. [PR #5869](https://github.com/Hmbown/Codewhale/pull/5869)
8. **#5889**: A closed PR that makes the homepage terminal preview more compact, improving the website's user interface. [PR #5889](https://github.com/Hmbown/Codewhale/pull/5889)
9. **#5884**: A closed PR for the Codewhale v0.9.12 release candidate, marking a significant update to the platform. [PR #5884](https://github.com/Hmbown/Codewhale/pull/5884)
10. **#5865**: A closed PR that re-lands FEAT-020 plugin command shapes on main, contributing to the ongoing development of the CodeWhale TUI crate decomposition. [PR #5865](https://github.com/Hmbown/Codewhale/pull/5865)

### Feature Request Trends
The community is showing a strong interest in enhancements related to user experience, stability, and feature expansion, including better support for international inputs, more intuitive menu systems, and advanced voice input capabilities. There's also a focus on improving the development and deployment process, with requests for more efficient and reliable testing, packaging, and release mechanisms.

### Developer Pain Points
Developers are experiencing frustrations with the current state of issue tracking, release management, and testing stability. There are recurring issues with network errors causing engine stops, difficulties with managing and displaying progress during startup, and challenges in maintaining a clean and efficient codebase. Additionally, the need for better documentation, particularly for Chinese-speaking users, and more robust support for various input methods and devices is highlighted. Addressing these pain points is crucial for improving the overall development experience and the quality of the DeepSeek TUI platform.
